text:
alex: Heads-up — seeing a billing delta for org:acme during last 10m, +27% tokens compared to logs. Anyone else?
priya: pinging @sam @jorge — noticed same on /v1/complete calls. looks like retries are charging both prompt+completion twice when tool calls present :thinking_face:
sam: Can you paste example request/response? my initial hunch is double-count in retry path where toolcall tokens are appended to completion count
alex: pasted sample:
```
POST /v1/complete
{"prompt":"...","max_tokens":256,"tools":["search"],"retry_id":"r-123"}
```
response headers:
`X-Tokens-Prompt: 120, X-Tokens-Completion: 250, X-Tool-Tokens: 40`
billing row shows 410 tokens, but combined logs show 360
jorge: that mismatch screams that our metering job adds tool tokens to completion again when retry_id present (we do a naive sum over traces)
priya: infra-bot ran meter-reconcile for 10m window at 1845239000 — output attached below
infra-bot: reconcile job summary: scanned 1,482 requests, applied +4,032 token adjustments, 98% completed. sample diff: request r-123: billed 410 -> corrected 360
sam: If true, root is code in meter/ingest:countTokens where we merge toolTokens into completionTokens on replay. I'll open a patch.
alex: Also affects per-key burst accounting because quota enforcer sees billed amount, not corrected. So some keys are getting transiently blocked
jorge: temp mitigation: we can change quota enforcer to use traced tokens if present (traced_tokens header) until fix
priya: agree. Sam can you make canary on staging + add feature flag? we need to add a console dashboard alert for sudden per-key surge too
sam: will do. PR wip, will add unit tests for retry path and add integration test with toolcall that includes `toolToken`
alex: nice. also add a backfill script to reconcile last 24h for affected orgs
sam: one Q — do we treat tool tokens charged to org or to model owner? currently org. need to keep that consistent in reconciliation
jorge: org. that's how billing page shows it
priya: ok next steps: sam -> PR + canary (staging), infra -> temp quota routing change, alex -> run backfill script after sam's merge, priya -> create console alert rule
alex: thanks. filing a short incident ticket so CS can proactively message customers
priya: filed INCIDENT-2026 in incidents channel :white_check_mark:
sam: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/commit/abc123
alex: closing loop — will monitor metrics in the next 2h :eyes:
